item.title: Chrome Adds Split View, PDF Notes, and Drive Saving Tools
item.description: Google is rolling out three Chrome upgrades: split view for side-by-side tabs, built-in PDF highlighting and notes, plus one-click Save to Drive. The post Chrome Adds Split View, PDF Notes, and Drive Saving Tools appeared first on TechRepublic.

item.title: Scammers Use Fake Gemini AI Chatbot for Crypto Scam
item.description: Scammers used a fake Gemini AI chatbot to promote a bogus Google Coin presale, signaling a rise in AI-driven crypto impersonation fraud. The post Scammers Use Fake Gemini AI Chatbot for Crypto Scam appeared first on TechRepublic.

item.title: Etsy Sells Depop to eBay for $1.2B in Strategic Reset
item.description: Etsy will sell Depop to eBay for about $1.2 billion, reversing its 2021 acquisition and refocusing on the Etsy marketplace. The post Etsy Sells Depop to eBay for $1.2B in Strategic Reset appeared first on TechRepublic.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Glass Storage That Could Preserve Data for 10,000 Years
item.description: Microsoft’s Project Silica can store 5TB of data on glass for 10,000 years, offering a durable, energy-free solution to prevent data rot. The post Microsoft Unveils Glass Storage That Could Preserve Data for 10,000 Years appeared first on TechRepublic.

item.title: Microsoft: Critical Security Issue Found in Windows Notepad

item.title: Google Blocked 1.75M Harmful Apps From Play Store in 2025

item.title: PayPal Flaw Exposed Email Addresses, Social Security Numbers for 6 Months
